traditional_secular.name: Traditional vs. Secular-Rational Values
traditional_secular.description: Traditional values emphasize the importance of religion, parent-child ties, deference to authority and traditional family values. Secular-rational values have the opposite preferences to the traditional values.

survival_expression.name: Survival vs. Self-Expression Values
survival_expression.description: Survival values place relatively high priority on economic and physical security. Self-expression values give high priority to environmental protection, growing tolerance of foreigners, gays and lesbians and gender equality, and rising demands for participation in decision-making in economic and political life.
